column1: # One row per IEEE-1800-only keyword the profile-filtered reach analysis can arrive at.
# A keyword with no row REFUSES the census: a new reachable keyword cannot land silently.
# SV-CORPUS-GRAD.3.39 — the optional FOURTH column names an IDENTIFIER WITNESS (leg 4): a keyword
# that leg 3 proves consumed as a keyword is still not an over-acceptance when IEEE 1364-2005 gives
# the word that role outside Annex B — clause 19.8's `timescale time_unit (s / ms / us / ns / ps /
# fs). The census earns the row mechanically: the keyword sits only on backtick-led lines of its
# witness, and the identifier witness accepts under verilog_2005 before AND after the word is
# swapped for a fresh identifier. See stimuli/sv/v2005_keyword_faithfulness_census.py.
